facts.fact: Levellers says the Presidency launched the Plan National du Numerique Horizon 2025 in September 2019, built on four pillars: infrastructure, content, applications and governance.
The government launched a drafting commission on 8 October 2025 for the successor Plan National du Numerique 2026-2030 (PNN 2), still in drafting as of June 2026 per Levellers.
Levellers says the PNN 2 and first AI strategy drafting launch was backed by a USD 1 billion Treasury investment for 2026 to 2030.
